title: Keel
summary: Engineering rules for an app of React and TypeScript in a Tauri shell, over SQLite: the stack, the build, type safety and the JSON boundary.
description: Rules that hold across the whole code base, out of sight like a keel, so that what a compiler or a linter can catch never reaches review.

requirements.text: The frontend is React and TypeScript in a Tauri 2 shell; SQLite runs in Rust and the frontend queries it through drizzle.
`bun run build` typechecks `src/`, lints everything and bundles, and fails on any type or lint error.
Frontend packages are installed only once they have been published for `keel.deps-minimum-age`.

values.description: How long a package version must have been published before it is installed.
